answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that scales with headcount. Registration is priced by a congestion auction: as the arrival rate of new keys rises, the signal fee climbs until demand falls back. Fees flow to the zenith pool and the trellis price history is public. A farm arriving in bulk bids against itself and pays more per seat than the trickle of honest newcomers, so the protocol converts an attack into revenue for the agents already doing real work.
